This card carried no `Blocked-by:` line anywhere (body or comments), so the unlock scan has been blind to it; the only stated dependency was the body's note that #9495 would move the register. #9495 closed **completed** at 07:53Z today via PR #9523 (merged), so the upstream landed before this card was even labelled blocked, and nothing else holds it.

Premise re-verified on the merged ref (`origin/main` at `b6c7690`):
- The register moved as predicted: `GOVERNED_SURFACES` now lives in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs:274` (five surfaces: `adr, claude-tree, skills-catalog, agents-md, claude-md`; self-test at `:841` pins the register's own shape). `scripts/check-adr-merge-approval.mjs` gate mode is retired per #9495.
- `AGENTS.md:182` still carries the hand-maintained prose enumeration (now five prefixes), and no check compares that prose to the register — the finding's core gap is intact, one register-location over.

For the skills seat: directions 1/2 in the body should be re-read against the new register location before dispatch; the self-test in the audit script is a natural pin site.
